metadata.description: Free marketing tools from InnoMaker Partners. Add this repo in the Claude app, then install any tool below as a plugin.

plugins.name: content-at-scale
plugins.description: Produce many content pieces in one run, with the quality control inside the run.

plugins.name: workflow-workarounds
plugins.description: Two skills for platforms that give Claude no clean API or an awkward OAuth wall.

plugins.name: marketing-scraping
plugins.description: Competitor-ad, customer-review, and search-result research on your own Apify account.

plugins.name: linkedin-follower-tracker
plugins.description: Track how your LinkedIn following changes over time, enriched and classified. (Plugin form; an n8n form also ships in this tool's folder.)

plugins.name: meeting-intel
plugins.description: Research external meeting participants and produce briefs before your calls. (Plugin form; Make.com forms also ship in this tool's folder.)
